en: The Pair on What is to be Abandoned by Seeing (Dassanenapahātabbaduka)
Dependent on a state to be abandoned by insight (*dassanena pahātabba*), a state to be abandoned by insight arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by insight (*nanadassanena pahātabba*), a state not to be abandoned by insight arises by way of the root condition … three [cases].
Dependent on a state both to be abandoned by insight and not to be abandoned by insight, a state to be abandoned by insight arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
